big_picture: Develop the strongest governed Henry Hub trading decision system in staged evidence layers before any protected confirmation opening.
why_zoomed_in: Phase 2 establishes the market-only benchmark that later fundamentals and specialist models must beat incrementally.
tested_role_target_horizon: Market-only predictors for the frozen five-executable-interval exact-contract trading target.

historical_facts.observed: Phase-2 development selected histgb-core-v1 with positive nested and aggregate net P&L under the inherited risk and cost engine.
historical_facts.rules_out: It rules out treating more complex curve features as automatically superior within the frozen Phase-2 grid.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: It does not establish confirmatory trading edge or rule out incremental value from PIT fundamentals or specialist models.

useful_secondary_observations: Short-side development contribution exceeded long-side contribution.
revisit_trigger: Revisit only when a later governed phase supplies new information or a material design change.
programme_interpretation: Use histgb-core-v1 as the frozen market-only comparator for later phases; keep 2023+ protected confirmation unopened.
